# Chintz Creative

> Chintz Creative is the studio of Bailey Powers, who paints custom watercolor commissions, hand lettering and hand painted birthday banners to order. Every piece is made by hand.

## Pages
- [Custom watercolor paintings](https://chintzcreative.com/custom-watercolor): personalized watercolors for milestone birthdays, monogram crests, hometown and alma mater pieces, weddings, nurseries and memorials.
- [Hand lettering and chalkboard art](https://chintzcreative.com/hand-lettering): wedding welcome signs, menus, seating charts, place cards, restaurant chalkboards and menu boards, framed quotes and verses in brush script and serif styles.
- [Hand painted birthday banners](https://chintzcreative.com/birthday-banners): name, age, theme and colors; first birthdays, kids' parties, milestone birthdays, graduations and baby showers.
- [Hand painted gifts](https://chintzcreative.com/hand-painted-gifts): personalized Christmas ornaments (including North Carolina state ornaments lettered UNC, NCSU, Carolina girl or a hometown), painted cutting boards, paddles and floral notebooks, single or in sets.
- [Commission intake form](https://chintzcreative.com/commission): the way to order. Asks for project type, details, reference photos, date, budget and contact.

## Example work
- A custom 40th birthday watercolor with a BEK monogram crest, 1986, Wendell NC, an NC State pennant and wolf, a cross and hand lettered happy 40th birthday, framed in gold.
- A custom watercolor keepsake with an SLW monogram crest surrounded by painted favorites: Pepsi, a VW badge, a cinnamon roll, a horseshoe, Red Man, coffee and the Massey Ferguson logo.
- A botanical watercolor of an orange branch, hand lettered "a taste of home".
- Hand lettered chalkboard menu art for a restaurant: "fall never tasted so good", a cow at a campfire for a s'mores milkshake, and a chicken and waffles sandwich.

- Hand painted banners: a pink bow happy 18th birthday Emerson banner, a Noah's ark welcome baby Mills shower banner, and an Auburn Samford Hall congrats Don graduation banner.

## About the name
Chintz was hand painted cotton from India's Coromandel Coast, banned by France in 1686 and England in 1720 because local mills could not compete. The studio reclaims that original meaning: bright, many colored, made by hand.
